annotations.title: Search Instagram's popular reels on a topic

description: The reels Instagram lists on its public popular page for a topic: shortcode, author, caption, exact play count and the date read off the media id. This is indexed discovery, not a hashtag feed. Instagram publishes these pages for some words only (`art`, `travel` and `music` have one; `fitness` and `nasa` did not when measured), lists up to 12 reels, and says in `hasMore` when it has more that cannot be read without signing in. A word with no page answers `indexed: false` and costs nothing. Cached for thirty minutes.

limit.description: Reels to return, 1–12. One page is one read: a smaller `limit` on the same topic is served from it.

q.description: The topic, the way Instagram names its popular pages: one word or a few ("travel", "street photography"). Not every word has a page.

refresh.description: Read the page again instead of serving the half-hour cache. Charged like any read, and the fresh answer replaces the cached one.
